✨ Matakana Lantern Festival ✨ Saturday 14 November, 5–10pm at the Village Green. Lanterns, food stalls, fire show at 9. Free entry, koha welcome.

We need volunteers! Set-up 2–5pm (8 people), gate and info table 5–10pm (4 people), pack-down Sunday 15 Nov 9–11am (6 people). Volunteers get a free festival tee. Sign up at lanternfest.example.org/volunteer
